items.title: Dashboard route: tidy up the redundant `return await`

seededDefectKey.scenario: A REP calls GET /api/dashboard?ownerId=<someone else>, or any caller arrives without a session.
seededDefectKey.consequence: withAuth returns a promise; `return promise` inside `try` hands it back un-awaited, so the ApiError (403/401) rejects after the try/catch has exited. toErrorResponse never runs and the client gets a generic 500 instead of 403/401.

seededDefectKey.scenario: This is the exact bug the six other authenticated handlers in the shipped repo already have; dashboard is the only one written correctly.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Accepting the patch spreads the A1 defect to the only handler that has a route-level test, so the test suite stops catching the pattern anywhere.

tests.name: rejects a rep trying to filter another owner's leads with 403 (ported from src/tests/auth-route-guards.test.ts)
tests.code: const res = await mod.GET({ session: { id: 'rep-user', role: 'REP' }, query: { ownerId: 'manager-user' } }); assert.equal(res.status, 403); assert.equal(res.body.code, 'FORBIDDEN');

tests.name: no session maps to 401, not a thrown error
tests.code: const res = await mod.GET({ session: null, query: {} }); assert.equal(res.status, 401); assert.equal(res.body.code, 'UNAUTHORIZED');

tests.name: a manager may filter by another owner
tests.code: const res = await mod.GET({ session: { id: 'm1', role: 'MANAGER' }, query: { ownerId: 'rep-user' } }); assert.equal(res.status, 200);
